message: api key rejected: it is wrong, expired, disabled, or out of credit

title.en: 401 API key rejected: it is wrong, expired, disabled, or out of credit
title.id: 401 API key ditolak: salah, kedaluwarsa, nonaktif, atau saldo habis

cause.en: The key is wrong, expired, disabled, or its quota is used up (status Exhausted in the API Keys menu). Ezkielyna keys only work on api.ezkielyna.store.
cause.id: Key salah, kedaluwarsa, nonaktif, atau kuotanya habis (status Exhausted di menu API Keys). Key Ezkielyna hanya berlaku di api.ezkielyna.store.

user_fix.en: Send it as `Authorization: Bearer sk-...` and check the key's status on the API Keys page. Claude Code uses `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` without `/v1` plus `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`.
user_fix.id: Kirim sebagai `Authorization: Bearer sk-...` dan cek status key di halaman API Keys. Claude Code memakai `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` tanpa `/v1` dan `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`.

operator_fix.en: Not applicable: this is the gateway's own answer to a client-side key problem.
operator_fix.id: Tidak berlaku: ini jawaban gateway untuk masalah key di sisi klien.

cause.en: The request went to the store website or to a path without `/v1`, not to the API host.
cause.id: Request dikirim ke alamat toko atau ke path tanpa `/v1`, bukan ke host API.

user_fix.en: Use `https://api.ezkielyna.store/v1` for OpenAI-format clients and `https://api.ezkielyna.store` (no `/v1`) for Anthropic-format clients. The same key works.
user_fix.id: Pakai `https://api.ezkielyna.store/v1` untuk klien format OpenAI dan `https://api.ezkielyna.store` (tanpa `/v1`) untuk klien format Anthropic. Key yang sama tetap berlaku.

message: is not available for your \w+ key group

title.en: 503 Model is not available for your key group
title.id: 503 Model tidak tersedia untuk grup key-mu

cause.en: The key's group does not include this model (for example a Standard key calling a Claude model), or all of its routes are busy.
cause.id: Grup key tidak mencakup model ini (misalnya key Standard memanggil model Claude), atau semua rutenya sedang sibuk.

user_fix.en: Create a key in the Auto group or in a group that lists the model; check the model's group on its model page.
user_fix.id: Buat key di grup Auto atau grup yang mencantumkan model itu; cek grup model di halaman modelnya.

title.en: 403 Insufficient quota (token quota is not enough)
title.id: 403 Saldo habis (token quota is not enough)

cause.en: The Wallet balance is empty or the key's own quota limit was reached.
cause.id: Saldo Wallet kosong atau batas kuota key sudah tercapai.

user_fix.en: Top up API Credit and redeem it in Wallet, or raise the key quota in API Keys. Retrying does not help.
user_fix.id: Isi API Credit lalu tukarkan di Wallet, atau naikkan kuota key di API Keys. Retry tidak membantu.

message: upstream rate or capacity limit reached

title.en: 429 Upstream rate or capacity limit reached
title.id: 429 Batas rate atau kapasitas upstream tercapai

cause.en: The model provider behind the gateway is busy. A 429 also appears above 300 requests per minute or 50 parallel requests from one IP.
cause.id: Penyedia model di belakang gateway sedang sibuk. 429 juga muncul di atas 300 request per menit atau 50 request paralel dari satu IP.

user_fix.en: Wait for `Retry-After`, lower concurrency and retry shortly, or try another model from the status page.
user_fix.id: Tunggu sesuai `Retry-After`, kurangi paralel lalu ulangi sebentar lagi, atau coba model lain dari halaman status.
